title: Universal Animation Menu Keyless
features:
This script provides an Animation Menu system that allows users to play various animations or emotes easily through a modern and simple user interface.

The menu includes a list of animations that can be played directly, along with a search feature to quickly find specific animations. In addition, users can copy animations from other players in the server using the Copy Emote Player system.

The script also supports Animation Speed and Emote Speed adjustments, allowing users to customize how fast the animations play. For greater flexibility, a Custom Animation ID feature is included, enabling users to run animations manually using their own animation IDs.

Key features and improvements included in this script:

• Animation List
A collection of various animations and emotes that can be played directly from the menu.

• Search Animation
Allows users to quickly find animations through the built-in search system.

• Copy Emote Player
Copies the animation currently being used by other players in the server.

• Lock Animation
Keeps the animation active without being interrupted.

• Speed Control
Adjusts the speed of animations and emotes for a more customized experience.

• Custom Animation ID
Allows users to run animations manually using a specific animation ID.

Overall, this script focuses on usability, flexible animation control, and a clean interface, providing a smoother and more convenient animation experience during gameplay.
